items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Charlie McCurtis? No, no. One of them, Tio's. Tio, what's his name? Lorenzo.

ctx.x: He had your own style, didn't he? No, no, he was mentioning about the guy that was playing, you know. What was the guy who was working at the, working with, what's the name of this, Piku? Piku. Yeah, it was another fellow who used to work with Robichaud. Charlie McCurtis? No, no. One of them, Tio's. Tio, what's his name? Lorenzo.
Yeah. That's the one. We just played some of his records yesterday.
